## `neuro.uint8ClampedArray.findLast`

Instance method on `Uint8ClampedArray.prototype`.

> Returns the value of the last element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
> otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
findLast(input: { uint8ClampedArray: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: number; index: number; array: Uint8ClampedArray) => boolean; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<S>
findLast(input: { uint8ClampedArray: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: number; index: number; array: Uint8ClampedArray) => unknown; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8ClampedArray.prototype.findLast` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
